full_judgment:
6C. Mr. Md. Abdus Salam Mondal, the learned Advocate appearing for the defendant-petitioner supporting the Rule and opposing the judgment of the Courts below submits that 8.38 acres of land appertains to C.S. Khatian Nos.490 and 477 corresponding to hal Khatian Nos1558 and 540 is a Wakf Estate which is known as Khan Bahadur Afzalur Rahman Wakf Estate and within this Wakf Estate there is a mosque and dargah which is locally known as "Utkhara Dargah Share at Debiddar, Comilla. The wakf was created and maintained before operation as wakf by user and the present defendant No.56 was appointed as regular motowalli from 1998 but before 1998 he was official motowalli also of the wakf estate and the wakf estate was enrolled through. Enrolment Case No.9095 and from the time immemorial, the local people have been trying to grab the wakf land in this or that way and as part of the said ill device by this time 4 regular suits have been filed so far save and except the present suit. Those are Title Suit Nos.153 of 1976, 357 of'1984, 47 of 1993 and 9 of 1995 but none of the suit has been decided in favour of the plaintiff so far and against the wakf estate. But even then the plaintiff knowing all the fact and figures regarding the former suits has filed the present test suit again concealing all the facts relating t.0 the suit land. The plaintiff did not make the defendant No.56 as the motowalli of the Wakf Estate. The defendant No.56 after filing of the written statement filed a separate petition under Order VII Rule 11 of the Code for rejection of the plaint mainly on two grounds that the suit is barred by the principle of res judicata and also the suit is barred under Section 102 of the Waqf Ordinance, 1962. 

 18. As I have told it earlier that the plaintiff had filed a suit as if he has no knowledge about the character of the suit land. As such there is no any reflection that either the entire suit land or its part is wakf property or not. The plaint is going to show that the plaintiff sought a saham for 0.6650 acres of land out of total partible 8.38 acres of land which appertains to have been recorded in C.S. Khatian Nos.490 and 477. 

 19. The learned Advocate for the plaintiff-opposite party No.1 very strongly argued before me that the suit land was recorded in the name of the predecessor of the plaintiff in C.S. record of right and pursuant to the C.S. record of right in S.A. record the suit land has been recorded in the name of the predecessors of the plaintiff and in support of his such contention he referred those khatians filed during the hearing through affidavit-in-reply. 

 20. On the other hand the petitioner during the hearing of this Rule filing supplementary affidavit with some papers showed that 8.38 acres of land appertains to C.S. Khatian Nos.490 and 477 corresponding to S.A. Khatian Nos.558 and 540 have been enrolled as wakf property in the name and style of Khan Bahadur Afzalur Rahman Wakf Estate, Comilla through enrollment Case No.9095 and in this connection the Memo No.1023(1), Comilla dated 16.02.1998 issued by the office of the Wakf Administrator is very much relevant to note here. Thus it is evident from the said memo dated 16.02.1998 that the entire 8.38 acres of land which is the suit land also has been enrolled as wakf property.
